div.div: p0 = Grandmaster (WPC NIC with connected GNSS), p1 = GrandmasterSibling (same WPC NIC). Solver: StepIsWPCNic+HasGNSSDevice on p0; StepIsWPCNic+StepSameNic(p0,p1) on p1. No inter-node LAN constraint.
